text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Mejiro Bright seemed to be
fussing over her forehead—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Actually, a tiny little pimple popped right up on my face~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have been maintaining a very disciplined lifestyle lately,
so why could this be~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Leaving that aside for now,
I came here today to share some of this
with you, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Here are some macarons~.
They were gifted to me by a long-established pastry shop, so please, do help yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Light and crispy,
it pairs so wonderfully with black tea
that I just can't help eating too much~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Could that be the cause of her rough skin...?
Either way, Mejiro Bright seems to be troubled by skin problems..."
